verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents trial handling: billing periods such as trials and renewals, and a Trial Offer API covering free and paid introductory periods with discounted rates for a limited time. Webhooks for subscription status transitions and Billing automations for customer communications suggest notification building blocks, but a PM noted customer emails are off by default. Missing for 10: explicit coupon and promotion-code evidence, documented automatic trial-to-paid conversion, card-network-compliant trial-end reminder notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration.
